description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mechanized Ninja Cavalry, adding {C}{C}.
When Mechanized Ninja Cavalry dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Mechanized Ninja Cavalry from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mechanized Ninja Cavalry enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
